caption: Soorarai Pottru: 2 things were real. 1 was changed.

The ₹1 ticket was real (Air Deccan, 2003, early birds only). Bommi is the real Bhargavi Gopinath, and her bakery still runs. But the real Captain Gopinath was in the Army, not the Air Force. That change is called dramatic licence.
Biopic or fiction: what do you call it?
